svg.title: Deployments / Yayındakiler
svg.desc: Status board, snapshot checked on 2026-11-15. Live sites answering HTTP 200: altyapi.frudotz.com (broadband infrastructure lookup, JavaScript), cs2.frudotz.com (Steam account trust analysis, Workers), v6.frudotz.com (IPv6 connectivity test, HTML), noctera.stream (label site, TypeScript). Repositories: ISU-SecOps-Engine (HTTP security header analyzer, Rust), ISU-SecOps-CFTunnelAuditor (cloudflared setup audit, Shell), ISU-SecOps-Nginx-RCE (pentest course lab BGT006, Python).
